name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Bahrain says it intercepted Iranian aerial attacks on 21 Nov; US blockade of Iranian ports continues; no ceasefire
state: Bahrain's state TV said its air defences intercepted Iranian aerial attacks late on 21 Nov, and a fire broke out at an industrial site. The same day Iran said it shot down a US drone over Qeshm Island (Gulf News). Iran calls the US blockade of its ports, now more than 130 days old, an act of war; Trump said on 22 Nov that tankers trying to breach it would be sunk (Euronews). Indirect talks via Qatar continue, and Trump said he may resume strikes after the new year if there is no deal (Iran International, 23 Nov).
for_you: Gulf airspace, ports and energy facilities remain exposed to strikes. Anyone in or travelling to Bahrain, Qatar, the UAE or nearby states should follow FCDO travel advice and local authority alerts.
rubric_hit: Alert: active strikes between states and attacks on Gulf shipping (Iranian attack on Bahrain 21 Nov; tankers hit)

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
